items.question: Should the market's 'my offers' page show past trades (most recent 250), filterable by resource, price and date?
Should there be a daily login bonus that rewards players for logging in each day?
Should school capacities be changed to more realistic, larger numbers (in multiples of 5,000), with more primary schools needed per high school?

Should the starter tutorial be reworked to cover nation, provinces, food/distribution, consumer goods and trade first (war moved to a separate tutorial), be repeatable without rewards, and be skippable?
Should the game add calculators for land cost, city cost and building cost (all buildings) that show total cost between a starting and target amount?
Should the war history show which buildings were destroyed in each attack?
Should the war guide explain combat details (how soldiers, support and morale decide battles) more thoroughly?
Should war targets be easier to see, so that nations can reliably find who they can attack and who can attack them?
Should players be able to opt out of the coalition shared bank pot so their personal deposits stay separate and private from members with banking permissions?
Should the game add a public war history page showing every nation's past wars, who won, and what was lost or destroyed?
Should the farm land-based food bonus taper off at high land amounts instead of growing linearly with land?
Should coalition members be able to join each other's defensive wars without a separate MDP, and should the truce delay for joining a coalition member's defensive war be removed?
Should the World Assembly get the proposed new options (resolution durations, tiered sanctions) described in this suggestion?
Should wars be changed so they cannot end (e.g. via a one-sided collapse) in under 24 hours?
Should consumer goods (CG) production be reworked as described in this suggestion?
Should selling military units be discouraged, e.g. by removing standing military from the score calculation?
Should war cards in the War Room show available Action Points and be sorted by declaration date (instead of enemy score)?
Cheaper education buildings
Show education needs
Make provinces/buildings show how many people they employ
Add vacation mode to protect nation when life gets busy
